Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all Eligible Tenderers as mentioned below and as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet
(TDS) of the Tender Document. A) General Experience : (i) In case of individual Tenderer /Reputed Contractors/ Construction
Firms shall have minimum 10(ten) years of general experience in Construction works. (ii) In case of JVCA, Lead Partner as well as
other partners must have minimum 10(ten) years of General Experience in Building Construction works. Other details given in the
Tender Data Sheet (TDS).
B) Similar Experience & Work Cost (i) Successful completion experience as a Prime Contractor or Sub-Contractor or Management
Contractor in construction work of at least 1(one) No. of similar construction work including related Electrical Installation & Internal
Sanitary and Water Supply, etc. arrangement of minimum 8(eight) storied Single Building or Multiple building complex in a
boundary (at least one 8(eight) storied Building including minimum one basement) during the last 5(Five) years. (ii) Minimum value
of the above mentioned work shall be amounting Tk. 60,00,00,000.00 (Taka Sixty Crore).(iii) The above mentioned Single Building
Work or multiple building complex in a boundary should be completed in a single contract under Govt. / Semi-Govt./ Autonomous
bodies. C) The minimum amount of Liquid assets or credit facilities or Working Capital of the Tenderer: Tk. 12,00,00,000.00 (Taka
Twelve Crore). D) Required AATO shall be greater than Tk. 50,00,00,000.00 (Taka Fifty Crore).
Brief Description of Works : • Basement construction including Parking Facilities at Basement and Ground Floor.
• Construction of 10+1-storied RCC framed structure building.
• Internal sanitary and water supply arrangement.
• Underground Water Reservoir.
• Internal Electrification.
• Fire Fighting.
• Gas Connection.
• Anti-Termite Treatment.
• Pre cast Pile driving with Pressure hammer or latest Technology for pile driving.
• Other Ancillary Works.
